## What could be improved?

Describe the issue or suggestion clearly.

## Why does it matter?

Explain how the change would improve clarity, accessibility, professionalism, or factual accuracy.

## Evidence or example

If applicable, include an example or supporting evidence.

## Privacy reminder

Do not post passwords, API keys, tokens, private contact information, or other sensitive data.
